label: Vassal contract type
summary: The vassal contract type with the given key.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope. Write it as `contract_type:key`, where the key is the name of a vassal contract type defined in the game's files. The game's own scripts do not use it.

label: Contributor
summary: The character who funded this project contribution.
details: Works on a project contribution. If nobody has funded the contribution yet, there is no character.

label: Council owner
summary: The ruler whose council the character sits on.
details: If the character is not a councillor, the result is an empty character. The game's own scripts do not use it.

label: Active council task
summary: The task the character is currently working on as a councillor.
details: Works on a character who holds a council position. To pick the task of one specific council position instead, use the form with a key.

label: Council task of a position
summary: The active task of the given council position of the character.
details: Write it as `council_task:position`. The game's own documentation gives `scope:council_task_steward` as an example name for the steward position.

label: Councillor
summary: The character who carries out this council task.
details: Works on a council task and leads back to the character holding it.

label: Council task target
summary: The target of the task the character is currently doing as a councillor.
details: Works on a character. The game's documentation does not say what kind of thing the target is, and it can differ per task, so check the task you use.

label: County
summary: The de jure county title of a title or a province.
details: De jure means the county it belongs to by the title hierarchy, not necessarily the one whose holder controls it now. Works on a title or a province.

label: Active holy site of the county
summary: The first active holy site in the county.
details: A holy site counts as active when the county is held by the right faith and the site has a relic enshrined in it. If there is none, nothing is returned. The game's own scripts do not use it.

label: County controller
summary: The character who currently controls the county.
details: Works on a province, or on a barony or county title.

label: Court owner
summary: The ruler at whose court the character lives.
details: Works on a character.

label: Court position holder
summary: The character who currently holds the given court position at the character's court.
details: Write it as `court_position:position`, with the key of a court position type. Works on a character.

label: Court position type
summary: The court position type with the given key.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope. Write it as `court_position_type:key`. The game's own scripts do not use it.

label: Councillor of a type
summary: The character who holds the given council position on the character's council.
details: Write it as `cp:position`. The game's own documentation gives `scope:cp_steward` as an example name for the steward position.

label: Creator
summary: The character who made the artifact.
details: Works on an artifact.

label: Culture
summary: The culture of a character, a title or a province.
details: Works on a character, a title or a province.

label: Culture by key
summary: The culture with the given key.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope. Write it as `culture:key`, using the key of a culture defined in the game's files.

label: Culture head
summary: The character who leads the culture.
details: Works on a culture.

label: Culture innovation
summary: The culture innovation with the given key.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope. Write it as `culture_innovation:key`.

label: Culture pillar
summary: The culture pillar with the given key.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope. Write it as `culture_pillar:key`.

label: Culture tradition
summary: The culture tradition with the given key.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope. Write it as `culture_tradition:key`.

label: Current heir to the title
summary: The character who is currently the heir to the title.
details: Works on a title.

label: Current location
summary: The province where the travel plan currently is.
details: Works on a travel plan.

label: Legend owner
summary: The character who owns the legend now, or who owned it last.
details: Works on a legend. The game's own scripts do not use it.

label: Travel plan
summary: The character's current travel plan.
details: Works on a character.

label: De facto liege title
summary: The title that the title actually belongs to under the current holders.
details: De facto means in practice, which can differ from the de jure title above it. Works on a title. Vanilla uses it rarely.

label: De jure liege title
summary: The title that the title belongs to by the title hierarchy.
details: De jure means by the title hierarchy, for example a county inside its duchy, no matter who holds what now. Works on a title.

label: Dead character variable
summary: A variable set earlier on a dead character, read by its name.
details: Write it as `dead_var:name`, for example `dead_var:mortal_enemy`. Works on a character. The game's documentation does not say what kind of value comes back, and vanilla never uses it.

label: Decision
summary: The decision with the given key.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope. Write it as `decision:key`.

label: Default location
summary: The province where the character normally is when not travelling.
details: The game says this takes imprisonment and similar things into account. Works on a character.

label: Game define
summary: The number stored in one of the game's numeric defines.
details: Write it as `define:Namespace|Name`. It works anywhere, without a starting scope. The game's own scripts do not use it.

label: Departure location
summary: The province where the travel plan started.
details: Works on a travel plan.

label: Designated diarch
summary: The character the ruler has designated as diarch.
details: The game words this as a separate link from the active diarch (`diarch`). Works on a character.

label: Designated heir
summary: The character the ruler has named as their heir.
details: Works on a character.

label: Diarch
summary: The character who is currently the ruler's active diarch.
details: Works on a character.

label: Diarchy successor
summary: The next character in the diarchy's line of succession.
details: Works on a character.

label: Doctrine
summary: The doctrine with the given key.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope. Write it as `doctrine:key`.

label: Domicile
summary: The character's domicile.
details: If the character has none, the result is empty. Works on a character.

label: Domicile culture
summary: The culture that the domicile currently has.
details: Only exists when the type of domicile uses a culture. Works on a domicile.

label: Domicile faith
summary: The faith that the domicile's current rite belongs to.
details: Only exists when the type of domicile uses a faith. Works on a domicile.

label: Domicile location
summary: The province where the domicile currently is.
details: Works on a domicile.

label: Domicile rite
summary: The rite the domicile currently follows.
details: Only exists when the type of domicile uses a faith. Works on a domicile.

label: Duchy
summary: The de jure duchy title of a title or a province.
details: De jure means by the title hierarchy, not by who holds it now. Works on a title or a province.

label: Dummy female
summary: A placeholder female character that the game provides.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope.

label: Dummy male
summary: A placeholder male character that the game provides.
details: It works anywhere, without a starting scope.

label: Dynast
summary: The head of the dynasty.
details: Works on a dynasty, not on a character, although the game's documentation words it as if it did.

label: Dynasty
summary: The dynasty the character belongs to.
details: Works on a character.

label: Dynasty by key
summary: The dynasty with the given key.
details: Write it as `dynasty:key`. The game does not mark this one as a global link.

label: Dynasty founder
summary: The character who founded the dynasty.
details: Works on a dynasty.

label: Empire
summary: The de jure empire title of a title or a province.
details: De jure means by the title hierarchy, not by who holds it now. Works on a title or a province.
